intro.en: Northwestern region spanning Langhe, Roero, Monferrato, Alto Piemonte and Alpine foothill grape traditions.
intro.zh: 西北大区，涵盖 Langhe、Roero、Monferrato、Alto Piemonte 及阿尔卑斯山前葡萄传统。

body.en: Piemonte is an administrative region containing multiple independent PDOs.
body.zh: Piemonte 是包含多个独立 PDO 的行政大区。

body.en: Barolo is made from Nebbiolo.
body.zh: Barolo 使用 Nebbiolo。

body.en: Gavi is made from Cortese.
body.zh: Gavi 使用 Cortese。

body.en: Piemonte is an administrative region containing multiple independent PDOs.
body.zh: Piemonte 是包含多个独立 PDO 的行政大区。

body.en: Albarossa is Barbera × Chatus, bred at Conegliano in 1938.
body.zh: Albarossa 为 Barbera × Chatus，1938 年在 Conegliano 育成。

body.en: In Albarossa’s old pedigree this name referred to Chatus, not Nebbiolo.
body.zh: 在 Albarossa 旧亲本中，此名指 Chatus，非 Nebbiolo。

body.en: The Roero consortium traces local wine culture to pre-Roman Ligurian settlement; this is a regional historical account rather than a dated origin for individual grapes.
body.zh: Roero 协会将地方葡萄酒文化追溯至罗马前 Ligurian 聚落；这是地区历史说明，不是单个品种起源日期。

body.en: Langhe-Roero and Monferrato wine landscapes entered the UNESCO World Heritage list in June 2014.
body.zh: Langhe-Roero 与 Monferrato 葡萄酒景观于 2014 年 6 月列入 UNESCO 世界遗产。

body.en: Barolo moved from DOC recognition in 1966 to DOCG in 1980; this modern legal history is separate from much older viticulture.
body.zh: Barolo 于 1966 年获 DOC、1980 年获 DOCG，现代法律历史须与更古老栽培史分开。

body.en: Nascetta is particularly associated with Novello in the Langhe.
body.zh: Nascetta 尤其关联 Langhe 的 Novello。

body.en: Colline Saluzzesi provides the principal Quagliano PDO reference.
body.zh: Colline Saluzzesi 提供主要 Quagliano PDO 参考。

body.en: Gattinara belongs to Alto Piemonte, not the southern Langhe.
body.zh: Gattinara 属 Alto Piemonte，而非南部 Langhe。

body.en: The Tanaro is central to the Roero/Langhe geographical distinction.
body.zh: Tanaro 河对 Roero／Langhe 地理区分重要。

body.en: The Langhe lie in southern Piemonte at the foot of the Maritime Alps and Ligurian Apennines.
body.zh: Langhe 位于 Piemonte 南部、Maritime Alps 与 Ligurian Apennines 山麓。

body.en: Lower Langhe hills extend south from Alba on the Tanaro’s right bank towards the Ligurian mountains.
body.zh: Lower Langhe 丘陵由 Alba 沿 Tanaro 右岸向南延至 Ligurian 山地。

body.en: The historical Monferrato landscape lies largely in Alessandria and partly Asti, framed by the Po to the north and Tanaro, Belbo and Bormida to the south.
body.zh: 历史 Monferrato 景观主要在 Alessandria、部分在 Asti，北侧 Po，南侧 Tanaro、Belbo、Bormida。

body.en: Alto Piemonte’s Gattinara is tied to the Sesia area; Carema lies farther west at the Aosta Valley boundary.
body.zh: Alto Piemonte 的 Gattinara 关联 Sesia 一带；Carema 更靠西，位于 Aosta Valley 边界。

body.en: Volcanic porphyry distinguishes Gattinara’s geological reference.
body.zh: 火山斑岩为 Gattinara 重要地质特征。

body.en: Marine sedimentary sands are a characteristic Roero reference.
body.zh: 海相沉积砂为 Roero 典型参考。

body.en: Langhe and Roero contain marine sedimentary formations, but their sandstone, marl and clay proportions differ by site.
body.zh: Langhe 与 Roero 含海相沉积地层，砂岩、泥灰岩及黏土比例随地块变化。

body.en: Barolo is made from Nebbiolo.
body.zh: Barolo 使用 Nebbiolo。

body.en: Gavi is made from Cortese.
body.zh: Gavi 使用 Cortese。

body.en: Arneis defines Roero’s principal white category.
body.zh: Arneis 定义 Roero 主要白酒类别。

body.en: Pelaverga Piccolo is the principal grape, not Pelaverga Grosso.
body.zh: 主要葡萄为 Pelaverga Piccolo，非 Pelaverga Grosso。

body.en: Timorasso is central to the modern revival of Colli Tortonesi white wine.
body.zh: Timorasso 为 Colli Tortonesi 白酒当代复兴核心。

body.en: Pelaverga Piccolo and Pelaverga Grosso are distinct cultivars.
body.zh: Pelaverga Piccolo 与 Grosso 为不同品种。

body.en: Becuét is the Val di Susa name linked to Persan.
body.zh: Becuét 为关联 Persan 的 Val di Susa 地方名。

body.en: Bian Ver belongs with Verdesse.
body.zh: Bian Ver 应归于 Verdesse。

body.en: The shared name does not establish a white mutation of Barbera.
body.zh: 同名不能证明为 Barbera 白色突变。

body.en: This ambiguous name has applied to Barbera Bianca and Barbassese.
body.zh: 有歧义的名称曾用于 Barbera Bianca 及 Barbassese。

body.en: Lambrusca di Alessandria is Vitis vinifera, not Vitis labrusca.
body.zh: Lambrusca di Alessandria 属 Vitis vinifera，非 Vitis labrusca。

body.en: A surviving Bianchetto di Saluzzo accession confirms preserved material, not necessarily commercial production.
body.zh: Bianchetto di Saluzzo 种质存续证明材料保存，不一定证明商业生产。

body.en: Functionally female flowers require suitable pollination; poor set can cause variable yields.
body.zh: 功能性雌花需合适授粉，坐果不良使产量波动。

body.en: Low basal-bud fertility favours long pruning for Neretto di Bairo.
body.zh: Neretto di Bairo 基部芽结实性低，适合长梢修剪。

body.en: Roero’s thermal contrasts and storm/hail risk make slope exposure important; a single regional temperature label cannot describe every vineyard.
body.zh: Roero 温差及风暴冰雹风险使坡向重要，单一地区气温标签不能描述所有葡萄园。

body.en: Carema’s dry-stone terraces and stone-supported pergolas are a distinct mountain viticulture system, unlike mechanisable lowland rows.
body.zh: Carema 干砌梯田及石柱棚架构成独特山地栽培体系，不同于可机械化平地行植。

body.en: At least 95% Arneis.
body.zh: 至少 95% Arneis。

body.en: At least 95% Nebbiolo.
body.zh: 至少 95% Nebbiolo。

body.en: Minimum 38 months, including 18 in wood.
body.zh: 最低 38 个月，其中 18 个月木质容器。

body.en: Minimum 26 months, including 9 in wood.
body.zh: 最低 26 个月，其中 9 个月木质容器。

body.en: Dry aromatic wine is possible; the grape name does not require sweetness.
body.zh: 可以酿芳香型干白，品种名不要求甜度。

body.en: Cascina Castlet uses selected dried Uvalino grapes for Uceline.
body.zh: Cascina Castlet 使用精选风干 Uvalino 酿 Uceline。

body.en: Antoniolo, Nervi and Travaglini are consortium-listed Gattinara producers.
body.zh: Antoniolo、Nervi、Travaglini 为协会列明的 Gattinara 生产者。

body.en: Marenco provides an Albarossa reference; Cascina Castlet’s Uceline documents Uvalino recovery and fruit drying.
body.zh: Marenco 提供 Albarossa 参考；Cascina Castlet 的 Uceline 记录 Uvalino 恢复及风干。

body.en: Verduno Pelaverga’s peppery expression is associated with rotundone research reported in 2021.
body.zh: Verduno Pelaverga 胡椒表现关联 2021 年报告的 rotundone 研究。

body.en: Cold-temperate subcontinental conditions are modified by Alpine shelter and mild humid air from the Ligurian Sea.
body.zh: 偏凉温带亚大陆性条件受阿尔卑斯屏障及 Ligurian 海温和湿润气流调节。

body.en: The Barolo zone is relatively sheltered from wind while receiving Alpine currents and warm humid air rising from the Tanaro valley.
body.zh: Barolo 相对避风，同时受阿尔卑斯气流及 Tanaro 谷地上升暖湿气流影响。

body.en: Roero is relatively dry; its permeable sandy ground and limited temporary reserves make winter water recharge important.
body.zh: Roero 相对干燥，砂地高渗透性及有限短期储水使冬季补水重要。

q.en: Is Piemonte a single appellation?
q.zh: Piemonte 是单一法定产区吗？

a.en: Piemonte is an administrative region containing multiple independent PDOs.
a.zh: Piemonte 是包含多个独立 PDO 的行政大区。

q.en: Which grape defines Barolo?
q.zh: Barolo 的核心葡萄？

a.en: Barolo is made from Nebbiolo.
a.zh: Barolo 使用 Nebbiolo。

q.en: Which grape defines Gavi?
q.zh: Gavi 的核心葡萄？

a.en: Gavi is made from Cortese.
a.zh: Gavi 使用 Cortese。

q.en: Which white grape defines Roero?
q.zh: Roero 核心白葡萄？

a.en: Arneis defines Roero’s principal white category.
a.zh: Arneis 定义 Roero 主要白酒类别。

q.en: Which Pelaverga is used in Verduno Pelaverga?
q.zh: Verduno Pelaverga 使用哪个 Pelaverga？

a.en: Pelaverga Piccolo is the principal grape, not Pelaverga Grosso.
a.zh: 主要葡萄为 Pelaverga Piccolo，非 Pelaverga Grosso。

q.en: Which white grape is central to the Colli Tortonesi revival?
q.zh: Colli Tortonesi 白酒复兴核心葡萄？

a.en: Timorasso is central to the modern revival of Colli Tortonesi white wine.
a.zh: Timorasso 为 Colli Tortonesi 白酒当代复兴核心。

q.en: Where is Nascetta particularly associated?
q.zh: Nascetta 特别关联哪里？

a.en: Nascetta is particularly associated with Novello in the Langhe.
a.zh: Nascetta 尤其关联 Langhe 的 Novello。

q.en: Where is Quagliano an established PDO reference?
q.zh: Quagliano 的 PDO 参考在哪里？

a.en: Colline Saluzzesi provides the principal Quagliano PDO reference.
a.zh: Colline Saluzzesi 提供主要 Quagliano PDO 参考。

q.en: Is Gattinara in the Langhe?
q.zh: Gattinara 位于 Langhe 吗？

a.en: Gattinara belongs to Alto Piemonte, not the southern Langhe.
a.zh: Gattinara 属 Alto Piemonte，而非南部 Langhe。

q.en: Which river helps distinguish Roero from Langhe?
q.zh: 区分 Roero 与 Langhe 的重要河流？

a.en: The Tanaro is central to the Roero/Langhe geographical distinction.
a.zh: Tanaro 河对 Roero／Langhe 地理区分重要。

q.en: When were Langhe-Roero and Monferrato wine landscapes inscribed by UNESCO?
q.zh: 葡萄酒景观何时列入 UNESCO？

a.en: June 2014.

q.en: Which mountain systems frame southern Langhe?
q.zh: 南部 Langhe 由哪些山系构成背景？

a.en: The Maritime Alps and Ligurian Apennines.
a.zh: Maritime Alps 与 Ligurian Apennines。

q.en: Are Pelaverga Piccolo and Grosso synonyms?
q.zh: 两种 Pelaverga 是同义名吗？

a.en: Pelaverga Piccolo and Pelaverga Grosso are distinct cultivars.
a.zh: Pelaverga Piccolo 与 Grosso 为不同品种。

q.en: Which two broad air influences modify the Langhe’s subcontinental setting?
q.zh: 哪两类气流影响调节 Langhe 亚大陆性环境？

a.en: Alpine influence and mild humid Ligurian Sea air.
a.zh: 阿尔卑斯影响与 Ligurian 海温和湿润气流。

q.en: Which rivers frame the historical Monferrato landscape?
q.zh: 哪些河流界定历史 Monferrato 景观？

a.en: Po to the north; Tanaro, Belbo and Bormida to the south.
a.zh: 北侧 Po，南侧 Tanaro、Belbo、Bormida。

q.en: Does a surviving accession prove a commercial vineyard?
q.zh: 存续种质能证明商业葡萄园吗？

a.en: A surviving Bianchetto di Saluzzo accession confirms preserved material, not necessarily commercial production.
a.zh: Bianchetto di Saluzzo 种质存续证明材料保存，不一定证明商业生产。

q.en: What complicates Doux d’Henry fruit set?
q.zh: Doux d’Henry 坐果难点？

a.en: Functionally female flowers require suitable pollination; poor set can cause variable yields.
a.zh: 功能性雌花需合适授粉，坐果不良使产量波动。

q.en: Why use long pruning for Neretto di Bairo?
q.zh: 为何适合长梢修剪？

a.en: Low basal-bud fertility favours long pruning for Neretto di Bairo.
a.zh: Neretto di Bairo 基部芽结实性低，适合长梢修剪。

q.en: Why is winter water recharge important in Roero?
q.zh: Roero 为何冬季补水重要？

a.en: Permeable sandy soils and limited reserves occur in a relatively dry climate.
a.zh: 相对干燥气候下砂土渗透高且储水有限。

q.en: What vineyard structures characterise Carema?
q.zh: Carema 有何典型葡萄园结构？

a.en: Dry-stone terraces and pergolas supported by stone pillars.
a.zh: 干砌梯田及石柱支撑棚架。

q.en: Is Lambrusca di Alessandria Vitis labrusca?
q.zh: 它属于 Vitis labrusca 吗？

a.en: Lambrusca di Alessandria is Vitis vinifera, not Vitis labrusca.
a.zh: Lambrusca di Alessandria 属 Vitis vinifera，非 Vitis labrusca。

q.en: What geology characterises Gattinara?
q.zh: Gattinara 的地质参考？

a.en: Volcanic porphyry distinguishes Gattinara’s geological reference.
a.zh: 火山斑岩为 Gattinara 重要地质特征。

q.en: What parent material is associated with Roero?
q.zh: Roero 相关母质是什么？

a.en: Marine sedimentary sands are a characteristic Roero reference.
a.zh: 海相沉积砂为 Roero 典型参考。

q.en: What is Roero Arneis’s minimum grape proportion?
q.zh: Roero Arneis 最低比例？

a.en: At least 95% Arneis.
a.zh: 至少 95% Arneis。

q.en: What is Roero red’s minimum Nebbiolo proportion?
q.zh: Roero 红酒最低 Nebbiolo 比例？

a.en: At least 95% Nebbiolo.
a.zh: 至少 95% Nebbiolo。

q.en: What is Barolo’s standard minimum maturation?
q.zh: Barolo 普通款最低熟成？

a.en: Minimum 38 months, including 18 in wood.
a.zh: 最低 38 个月，其中 18 个月木质容器。

q.en: What is Barbaresco’s standard minimum maturation?
q.zh: Barbaresco 普通款最低熟成？

a.en: Minimum 26 months, including 9 in wood.
a.zh: 最低 26 个月，其中 9 个月木质容器。

q.en: What process distinguishes Uceline’s producer reference?
q.zh: Uceline 生产者参考的关键工艺？

a.en: Cascina Castlet uses selected dried Uvalino grapes for Uceline.
a.zh: Cascina Castlet 使用精选风干 Uvalino 酿 Uceline。

q.en: Must Malvasia Moscata be sweet?
q.zh: Malvasia Moscata 必须甜吗？

a.en: Dry aromatic wine is possible; the grape name does not require sweetness.
a.zh: 可以酿芳香型干白，品种名不要求甜度。

q.en: Which compound is linked to Verduno Pelaverga’s pepper aroma?
q.zh: 哪种化合物关联其胡椒香？

a.en: Verduno Pelaverga’s peppery expression is associated with rotundone research reported in 2021.
a.zh: Verduno Pelaverga 胡椒表现关联 2021 年报告的 rotundone 研究。

intro.en: Alpine valley with distinct local grapes and a regional DOC containing geographical and varietal identities.
intro.zh: 阿尔卑斯谷地，拥有独特地方葡萄及包含地理、品种身份的大区 DOC。

body.en: The Dora Baltea forms the principal vineyard corridor.
body.zh: Dora Baltea 构成主要葡萄园轴线。

body.en: Prié Blanc defines the upper-valley white reference.
body.zh: Prié Blanc 定义上谷地白酒参考。

body.en: Prëmetta is Prié Rouge.
body.zh: Prëmetta 即 Prié Rouge。

body.en: The administrative region and the protected wine denomination are separate entity types.
body.zh: 行政大区与受保护葡萄酒名称属于不同实体类型。

body.en: The regional DOC was established in 1985.
body.zh: 大区 DOC 建立于 1985 年。

body.en: The Dora Baltea forms the principal vineyard corridor.
body.zh: Dora Baltea 构成主要葡萄园轴线。

body.en: Upper-valley cultivation near Morgex reaches roughly 1,200 metres.
body.zh: Morgex 附近上谷地栽培约可达 1,200 米。

body.en: The wine area follows the Dora Baltea basin to Pont-Saint-Martin, with France west and Switzerland north.
body.zh: 葡萄酒地区沿 Dora Baltea 流域至 Pont-Saint-Martin，西邻法国、北邻瑞士。

body.en: Warm, exposed sites help late Fumin reach maturity.
body.zh: 温暖向阳地块帮助晚熟 Fumin 成熟。

body.en: High mountains limit incoming moisture, leaving inner valleys drier; high-altitude zones are colder and wetter than the sheltered central valley.
body.zh: 高山限制外来湿气，使内谷较干；高海拔区比受屏障保护的中谷地更冷湿。

body.en: Low rainfall, ventilation and marked day–night temperature differences shape the vineyard environment.
body.zh: 少雨、通风及明显昼夜温差塑造葡萄园环境。

body.en: Prié Blanc defines the upper-valley white reference.
body.zh: Prié Blanc 定义上谷地白酒参考。

body.en: Prëmetta is Prié Rouge.
body.zh: Prëmetta 即 Prié Rouge。

body.en: Petit Rouge is central to Torrette.
body.zh: Petit Rouge 为 Torrette 核心葡萄。

body.en: Vien de Nus is a principal component.
body.zh: Vien de Nus 为主要组成。

body.en: Nus Malvoisie refers to Pinot Gris.
body.zh: Nus Malvoisie 指 Pinot Gris。

body.en: Picotendro is the local Nebbiolo name.
body.zh: Picotendro 为 Nebbiolo 地方名。

body.en: Fumin is a red grape.
body.zh: Fumin 为红葡萄。

body.en: Shared naming alone does not prove a Prié Blanc–Prié Rouge mutation relationship.
body.zh: 共同名称不能证明 Prié Blanc 与 Rouge 的突变关系。

body.en: Cornalin d’Aoste corresponds to Humagne Rouge.
body.zh: Cornalin d’Aoste 对应 Humagne Rouge。

body.en: Swiss Cornalin du Valais is distinct from Cornalin d’Aoste/Humagne Rouge.
body.zh: 瑞士 Cornalin du Valais 不同于 Cornalin d’Aoste／Humagne Rouge。

body.en: Low pergolas use the relatively protected near-ground environment in the upper valley.
body.zh: 低棚架利用上谷地相对受保护的近地环境。

body.en: Many upper-valley vineyards are own-rooted, but status must be checked by vineyard.
body.zh: 许多上谷地园为自根，但须按园核实。

body.en: Thin fragile Prëmetta skins increase the importance of disease and rot management.
body.zh: Prëmetta 薄而脆弱的皮使病害及腐烂管理重要。

body.en: Mayolet is relatively early ripening.
body.zh: Mayolet 相对早熟。

body.en: Fumin is late ripening.
body.zh: Fumin 晚熟。

body.en: Much vineyard area occupies the sunny Adret on the Dora Baltea’s orographic left.
body.zh: 许多葡萄园位于 Dora Baltea 地形左岸向阳 Adret。

body.en: Blanc de Morgex et de La Salle, Enfer d’Arvier, Torrette, Nus, Chambave, Arnad-Montjovet and Donnas.
body.zh: Blanc de Morgex et de La Salle、Enfer d’Arvier、Torrette、Nus、Chambave、Arnad-Montjovet、Donnas。

body.en: A Torrette tasting note describes a blend, not necessarily pure Petit Rouge.
body.zh: Torrette 品鉴描述混酿，不一定描述纯 Petit Rouge。

body.en: Petit Rouge accompanies Vien de Nus in Nus Rouge.
body.zh: Nus Rouge 中 Petit Rouge 与 Vien de Nus 配合。

body.en: Long wood ageing is a producer choice, not a requirement arising solely from the grape name.
body.zh: 较长木桶熟成是生产者选择，并非品种名本身要求。

body.en: Blanc de Morgex et de La Salle includes still and sparkling references.
body.zh: Blanc de Morgex et de La Salle 有静止及起泡参考。

body.en: La Vrille provides a 100% Vuillermin reference.
body.zh: La Vrille 提供 100% Vuillermin 参考。

body.en: Grosjean documents Fumin, Petit Rouge and Prëmetta separately.
body.zh: Grosjean 分别记录 Fumin、Petit Rouge、Prëmetta。

body.en: Di Barrò provides a varietal Mayolet reference.
body.zh: Di Barrò 提供单品种 Mayolet 参考。

body.en: Prëmetta can be pale coral yet have appreciable tannin.
body.zh: Prëmetta 可呈浅珊瑚色但有明显单宁。

body.en: The regional reference describes a dry fruity red, paired locally with meat and cheese.
body.zh: 大区参考为干型果味红酒，当地配肉类及奶酪。

body.en: Glaciers shaped the valley system; vineyard elevation, slope and deposits vary within the main corridor.
body.zh: 冰川塑造谷地体系，主要走廊内葡萄园海拔、坡地及沉积物各异。

q.en: Can all Prié Blanc be described as ungrafted?
q.zh: 可称所有 Prié Blanc 均自根吗？

a.en: Many upper-valley vineyards are own-rooted, but status must be checked by vineyard.
a.zh: 许多上谷地园为自根，但须按园核实。

q.en: What site conditions matter for Fumin maturity?
q.zh: Fumin 成熟需要何种地块条件？

a.en: Warm, exposed sites help late Fumin reach maturity.
a.zh: 温暖向阳地块帮助晚熟 Fumin 成熟。

q.en: Does pale Prëmetta necessarily have little tannin?
q.zh: 浅色 Prëmetta 必然少单宁吗？

a.en: Prëmetta can be pale coral yet have appreciable tannin.
a.zh: Prëmetta 可呈浅珊瑚色但有明显单宁。

q.en: What skin trait affects Prëmetta management?
q.zh: 何种果皮特点影响管理？

a.en: Thin fragile Prëmetta skins increase the importance of disease and rot management.
a.zh: Prëmetta 薄而脆弱的皮使病害及腐烂管理重要。

q.en: Do the Prié names alone prove a mutation relationship?
q.zh: Prié 名称本身证明突变关系吗？

a.en: Shared naming alone does not prove a Prié Blanc–Prié Rouge mutation relationship.
a.zh: 共同名称不能证明 Prié Blanc 与 Rouge 的突变关系。

q.en: What cross-border identity is Cornalin d’Aoste?
q.zh: Cornalin d’Aoste 的跨境身份？

a.en: Cornalin d’Aoste corresponds to Humagne Rouge.
a.zh: Cornalin d’Aoste 对应 Humagne Rouge。

q.en: Why must the two Cornalin names be distinguished?
q.zh: 为何区分两个 Cornalin 名称？

a.en: Swiss Cornalin du Valais is distinct from Cornalin d’Aoste/Humagne Rouge.
a.zh: 瑞士 Cornalin du Valais 不同于 Cornalin d’Aoste／Humagne Rouge。

q.en: Can Torrette directly define pure Petit Rouge’s taste?
q.zh: Torrette 能直接定义纯 Petit Rouge 风味吗？

a.en: A Torrette tasting note describes a blend, not necessarily pure Petit Rouge.
a.zh: Torrette 品鉴描述混酿，不一定描述纯 Petit Rouge。

q.en: Which grape accompanies Vien de Nus in Nus Rouge?
q.zh: Nus Rouge 中与 Vien de Nus 配合的葡萄？

a.en: Petit Rouge accompanies Vien de Nus in Nus Rouge.
a.zh: Nus Rouge 中 Petit Rouge 与 Vien de Nus 配合。

q.en: Which producer offers a varietal Vuillermin reference?
q.zh: 哪个生产者提供单品种 Vuillermin？

a.en: La Vrille provides a 100% Vuillermin reference.
a.zh: La Vrille 提供 100% Vuillermin 参考。

q.en: Which producer documents Fumin and Prëmetta separately?
q.zh: 哪个生产者分别记录两品种？

a.en: Grosjean documents Fumin, Petit Rouge and Prëmetta separately.
a.zh: Grosjean 分别记录 Fumin、Petit Rouge、Prëmetta。

q.en: Which producer supplies a Mayolet reference?
q.zh: 哪个生产者提供 Mayolet 参考？

a.en: Di Barrò provides a varietal Mayolet reference.
a.zh: Di Barrò 提供单品种 Mayolet 参考。

q.en: Is Mayolet relatively early or late ripening?
q.zh: Mayolet 早熟还是晚熟？

a.en: Mayolet is relatively early ripening.
a.zh: Mayolet 相对早熟。

q.en: What maturation timing distinguishes Fumin?
q.zh: Fumin 的成熟时间特点？

a.en: Fumin is late ripening.
a.zh: Fumin 晚熟。

q.en: Must Fumin use wood solely because of its grape identity?
q.zh: Fumin 是否因品种身份就必须用木桶？

a.en: Long wood ageing is a producer choice, not a requirement arising solely from the grape name.
a.zh: 较长木桶熟成是生产者选择，并非品种名本身要求。

q.en: What approximate elevation is reached near Morgex?
q.zh: Morgex 附近约可达多高？

a.en: Upper-valley cultivation near Morgex reaches roughly 1,200 metres.
a.zh: Morgex 附近上谷地栽培约可达 1,200 米。

q.en: Name the upper-valley sparkling white reference.
q.zh: 上谷地白色起泡参考？

a.en: Blanc de Morgex et de La Salle includes still and sparkling references.
a.zh: Blanc de Morgex et de La Salle 有静止及起泡参考。

q.en: What is Nus Rouge’s broad style and local food context?
q.zh: Nus Rouge 大致风格及地方配餐？

a.en: The regional reference describes a dry fruity red, paired locally with meat and cheese.
a.zh: 大区参考为干型果味红酒，当地配肉类及奶酪。

q.en: Which grape is Chiavennasca?
q.zh: Chiavennasca 是什么品种？

a.en: Chiavennasca is Nebbiolo.
a.zh: Chiavennasca 即 Nebbiolo。

q.en: Which lake is north of Franciacorta?
q.zh: Franciacorta 北侧是哪座湖？

a.en: Lake Iseo lies north of Franciacorta.
a.zh: Iseo 湖位于 Franciacorta 北侧。

q.en: Which lake borders Lugana?
q.zh: Lugana 靠近哪座湖？

a.en: Lugana lies at southern Lake Garda.
a.zh: Lugana 位于 Garda 湖南部。

q.en: Which regions share Lugana?
q.zh: Lugana 跨哪两个大区？

a.en: Lugana is shared by Lombardia and Veneto.
a.zh: Lugana 跨 Lombardia 与 Veneto。

q.en: Is Oltrepò north or south of the Po?
q.zh: Oltrepò 在 Po 河以北还是以南？

a.en: Oltrepò lies south of the Po.
a.zh: Oltrepò 位于 Po 河以南。

q.en: What colour and aromatic type is Moscato di Scanzo?
q.zh: Moscato di Scanzo 颜色及芳香类型？

a.en: Moscato di Scanzo is a red aromatic grape.
a.zh: Moscato di Scanzo 为红色芳香葡萄。

q.en: What is Lugana’s principal local grape name?
q.zh: Lugana 主要葡萄地方名？

a.en: Turbiana is the principal local grape name in Lugana.
a.zh: Turbiana 为 Lugana 主要葡萄地方名。

q.en: Which grape group is associated with Valtènesi?
q.zh: Valtènesi 关联哪组葡萄？

a.en: Groppello is the emblematic local grape group.
a.zh: Groppello 为标志性地方葡萄群。

q.en: Is Sforzato necessarily sweet?
q.zh: Sforzato 必然为甜型吗？

a.en: Sforzato is a dry red made from dried grapes.
a.zh: Sforzato 为风干葡萄酿成的干红。

q.en: What method defines Franciacorta?
q.zh: 何种方法定义 Franciacorta？

a.en: Traditional method with secondary fermentation in bottle.
a.zh: 传统法，瓶中二次发酵。

q.en: Name Valtellina Superiore’s five subzones.
q.zh: 列出 Valtellina Superiore 五分区。

a.en: Maroggia, Sassella, Grumello, Inferno and Valgella.
a.zh: Maroggia、Sassella、Grumello、Inferno、Valgella。

q.en: What is the minimum Nebbiolo share?
q.zh: 最低 Nebbiolo 比例？

a.en: Valtellina Superiore requires at least 90% Nebbiolo.
a.zh: Valtellina Superiore 至少 90% Nebbiolo。

q.en: Name Lugana’s five communes.
q.zh: 列出 Lugana 五市镇。

a.en: Sirmione, Desenzano, Lonato, Pozzolengo and Peschiera del Garda.
a.zh: Sirmione、Desenzano、Lonato、Pozzolengo、Peschiera del Garda。

q.en: Which Lugana commune is wholly included?
q.zh: 哪个市镇全境纳入？

a.en: Sirmione is wholly included; specified parts of the other four communes are included.
a.zh: Sirmione 全境纳入，其他四市镇为指定部分。

q.en: What is Lugana’s minimum Turbiana share?
q.zh: Lugana 最低 Turbiana 比例？

a.en: Lugana requires at least 90% Turbiana.
a.zh: Lugana 至少 90% Turbiana。

q.en: When was Lugana DOC recognised?
q.zh: Lugana DOC 何时认可？

a.en: Lugana received DOC status in 1967.
a.zh: Lugana 于 1967 年获 DOC。

q.en: What is Lugana Superiore’s minimum maturation?
q.zh: Superiore 最低熟成？

a.en: Minimum 12 months maturation.
a.zh: 最低熟成 12 个月。

q.en: What is Lugana Riserva’s minimum maturation?
q.zh: Riserva 最低熟成？

a.en: Minimum 24 months, including at least 6 in bottle.
a.zh: 最低 24 个月，含至少 6 个月瓶陈。

q.en: Name Lugana’s five categories.
q.zh: 列出 Lugana 五类别。

a.en: Basic, Superiore, Riserva, Vendemmia Tardiva and Spumante.
a.zh: 基础款、Superiore、Riserva、Vendemmia Tardiva、Spumante。

q.en: Why distinguish Monte Orfano geologically?
q.zh: 为何地质上区分 Monte Orfano？

a.en: Monte Orfano has a substrate distinct from Franciacorta’s principal morainic landscape.
a.zh: Monte Orfano 基底不同于 Franciacorta 主要冰碛景观。

q.en: What trait makes Erbamat relevant to sparkling bases?
q.zh: Erbamat 对起泡基酒的主要价值？

a.en: Late ripening with retained high acidity is Erbamat’s principal sparkling-base interest.
a.zh: 晚熟保留高酸为 Erbamat 的主要起泡基酒价值。

q.en: May Satèn contain Erbamat?
q.zh: Satèn 可含 Erbamat 吗？

a.en: Erbamat is excluded from Satèn.
a.zh: Satèn 排除 Erbamat。

q.en: What is Erbamat’s maximum permitted share?
q.zh: Erbamat 最高比例？

a.en: Eligible Franciacorta categories allow at most 10% Erbamat.
a.zh: 适用 Franciacorta 类别最多 10% Erbamat。

q.en: Are Gentile and Mocasina merely clones of one grape?
q.zh: Gentile 与 Mocasina 只是克隆吗？

a.en: Gentile and Mocasina are separate cultivars, not merely two clones.
a.zh: Gentile 与 Mocasina 为不同品种，并非仅两个克隆。

q.en: Is Nebbiolo Rosé a Nebbiolo colour mutation?
q.zh: Nebbiolo Rosé 是颜色突变吗？

a.en: Nebbiolo Rosé is genetically distinct, not a proven colour mutation.
a.zh: Nebbiolo Rosé 遗传上独立，并非已证实颜色突变。

q.en: What kinship is supported for Rossola Nera?
q.zh: Rossola Nera 获支持的亲缘？

a.en: The 2020 study supports full-sibling relationships with Nebbiolo, Nebbiolo Rosé and Pignola.
a.zh: 2020 研究支持其与 Nebbiolo、Nebbiolo Rosé、Pignola 为全同胞关系。

q.en: Which four valleys structure Oltrepò?
q.zh: Oltrepò 四条重要谷地？

a.en: Versa, Scuropasso, Coppa and Staffora.
a.zh: Versa、Scuropasso、Coppa、Staffora。

q.en: Does the Oltrepò consortium represent only one wine category?
q.zh: Oltrepò 协会仅代表一个酒类别吗？

a.en: The Oltrepò consortium represents seven denomination identities, including Bonarda, Buttafuoco and Sangue di Giuda.
a.zh: Oltrepò 协会代表七个名称身份，包括 Bonarda、Buttafuoco、Sangue di Giuda。

q.en: What separates Moscato di Scanzo from fresh Moscato sparkling wine?
q.zh: Moscato di Scanzo 与清新 Moscato 起泡的区别？

a.en: Red aromatic fruit is dried before fermentation into a concentrated sweet red.
a.zh: 红色芳香果实先风干，再酿浓缩甜红。

q.en: Why are Sforzato and Moscato di Scanzo not equivalent dessert wines?
q.zh: 两者为何不是同类餐后酒？

a.en: Dry Sforzato and sweet Moscato di Scanzo need different service contexts despite both using dried fruit.
a.zh: 干型 Sforzato 与甜型 Moscato di Scanzo 虽都用风干果实，侍酒场景不同。
